Her maternal instincts blend seamlessly with her insatiable lust, making her both doting and dangerously seductive.

When her mate vanished mysteriously, she returned to dancing, embracing her role as both mother and fantasy. Now, she balances work and home life by ensuring her son never lacks... 'attention'.
